info.description:
## Vigil Parent App — API Test Collection

### 🔑 Credentials & Environment
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `http://160-153-179-249.sslip.io` |
| Parent Email | `parent@vigil.com` |
| Parent Password | `Parent@1234` |
| Environment | **Vigil env** (`35304629-fa1bd18d`) |

> The collection pre-request script auto-refreshes `token` via `POST /api/auth/login` before every request. `parentId` is captured automatically.
>
> ⚠️ If login returns **403**, activate the account via the Admin Panel collection → "10. Update User Status".

---

### ✅ Fully Automated (no device required)

| Folder | Endpoints | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Auth** | Register, Login, Verify OTP, Forgot/Reset Password | Login captures `token` + `parentId` |
| **2. Child Management** | Add Child, Get Children, Get Child by ID, Update Child, Delete Child | `childId` captured from Get All Children |
| **3. Device Pairing** | Generate Pairing Code, Get Pairing Code Status (polling) | `pairingCode` captured on generation — used by Child App to pair |
| **5. Location** | Create Geo Zone, Get Geo Zones (all/by child) | `geoZoneId` captured from Create Geo Zone |

---

### 🔒 Requires Physical Paired Device

The following endpoints require a real Android device that has completed the pairing flow:

| Folder | Endpoints | Device Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| **3. Device Pairing** | Pair Device, Check Pairing Status, Verify code | Child App on device must scan/enter pairing code |
| **4. Permission Setup** | Play Protect, Accessibility, App Supervision, Notification Access, Admin Access, Data Access, Battery Optimization, Device Name | Child device must be active and reporting; returns 404 if device has never connected |
| **5. Location** | Get/Add/Update Location History, Update Child Location, Toggle/Delete Geo Zone | Requires active device + `childId` from paired device |
| **6. Device Data** | Get All Device Data by Parent | Requires at least one active paired device |

---

### ⚠️ Known Limitations
- **Pairing Code → Child App dependency**: `pairingCode` generated here must be used in the Child App collection within its expiry window (typically a few minutes) to complete device pairing.
- **Permission endpoints → 404**: These return 404 if `childId` exists but the child has never connected with a physical device. A paired device must have called the corresponding status-update endpoints at least once.
- **Slow responses**: Register (~18s) and Get All Children (~5.4s) occasionally exceed the 5000ms threshold on this server — these are server-latency issues, not logic errors.
- **Check Pairing Code Status → 401**: Requires the child-side token (from the Child App), not the parent token.

---

### 🚦 Automation Status
- **Without paired device:** ~47% pass rate (auth + child management + pairing code generation + geo zone creation)
- **With paired device:** ~75%+ expected pass rate (device-data and permission endpoints unlock)

request.description:
**PRIMARY registration endpoint for the Vigil Web signup page.**

The frontend sends only `name` + `email` (`phone` optional). The backend automatically:
1. Generates a UNIQUE username from the user's name (e.g. "rahul_a4b3") — even two users with the same name get different usernames, and the username is checked against the DB so it can never collide.
2. Generates a UNIQUE secure temporary password per user (e.g. "Vigil@XUQn6nfe").
3. EMAILS both the username and the temporary password directly to the user's email address.

**No separate email API call is needed — registration + email happen in this one request.**

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Rahul Sharma",
  "email": "rahul@example.com",
  "phone": "9876543210"   // optional
}
```

**Success — 201:**
```json
{
  "status": 201,
  "msg": "Account created successfully! Check your email for your username and temporary password."
}
```
No token is returned. The welcome email contains ONLY the username + temporary password (no email field) — the user logs in (endpoint 2) with their USERNAME + that password. On first login, `must_reset_password` will be `true`, so redirect them to the Change Password screen (endpoint 3).

**Errors:**
- `400` `{ field, msg }` — missing name / invalid email
- `409` `{ field:'email', msg }` — email already registered (ask user to log in)
- `500` — server error

request.description: STEP 2 of pairing. Submit the OTP emailed to the parent. Returns: token (CHILD scoped JWT) + a PER-DEVICE unique deviceKey (vigil_dk_...) + childId + parentId. request.description:
Runs the day’s AI Behaviour Analysis for a child. Backend pulls that child’s SMS + call logs for `date`, maps them to the AI model format, calls the model (server-to-server), and returns the analysis.

**Auth:** parent JWT (Bearer {{token}}). Verifies the child belongs to you.

**Body:** `{ "date": "{{aiDate}}" }` — optional, defaults to today (IST).

**Verified 08 Jul 2026** with real seeded data (3 SMS + 2 calls) → returned wellness_score 99.4, band "good", + PDF report. A nightly cron (02:00 IST) also auto-runs this for every child’s previous day.

See the saved example response below for the exact shape.

response.name: 200 — Verified (3 SMS + 2 calls)

originalRequest.description:
Collects the child`s SMS + call logs for the given day, maps them into the AI service format, and runs the behaviour analysis.

**Auth:** parent JWT (Bearer token) + verifies the child belongs to you.

**Body:** `{ "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }` — optional; defaults to TODAY (IST). Usually you analyse a completed day (yesterday).

**Response (data found):** `{ status:200, analyzed:true, date, smsCount, callCount, result:{ ...daily_intelligence } }` — result has wellness_score, wellness_band, executive_summary, dominant_emotions, concerning_findings, recommendations, relationships, top_priorities, longitudinal trends, overall_confidence.

**Response (no data that day):** `{ status:200, analyzed:false, message:"No SMS or call logs found..." }`.

NOTE: a **daily cron runs this automatically at 02:00 IST for every child`s previous day** — this endpoint is for on-demand / "Generate Report" button. Added 03 Jul 2026.
